up: Show the exact activity values and structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1040694. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard relation, standard value, and standard units.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1040694'
